name: kilimcininkoroglu-mods
description: Claude Mods (function-hooks plugins) for Claude Code.

plugins.name: task-poke
plugins.description: Submits a continue prompt when a main-loop turn ends while the TodoWrite or Task tools list still has unfinished tasks, at most 5 times in a row. Turns the task tools on for every model unless CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS is set. Reach L2: one $.prompt.submit per turn, reads the transcript, sets one env variable, stores one boolean.

plugins.name: limit-watch
plugins.description: Shows the subscription usage limits under the prompt with a reset countdown and a projection, opens a /limits pane, and logs once when a limit passes 80% and 95%.
